title: An XAI Social Media Platform for Teaching K-12 Students AI-Driven Profiling, Clustering, and Engagement-Based Recommending
extended_summary:
This paper presents Somekone, an explainable AI (XAI) educational tool for K-12 classrooms that teaches students how social media platforms use data collection, profiling, engagement metrics, clustering, and recommendation algorithms. The authors motivate the tool as a response to the need for children and adolescents to understand the data-driven mechanisms behind social media rather than only learning general social media literacy or safety rules.

The intervention is an Instagram-like browser-based platform with real-time visualizations that show students how their actions generate data, shape profiles, and affect recommendation outputs. The system includes teacher-facing analytics views and student-facing views for browsing, profiling, and recommendations. The paper emphasizes collaborative classroom use, with students typically working in pairs and teachers projecting class-level visualizations.

The reported evidence is a case example and analytics from 12 two-hour test sessions with 209 children in grades 5 and 8 across schools in Finland. The paper does not report a controlled comparison against business-as-usual or another instructional condition; instead, it analyzes usage patterns through latent profile analysis and sequence analysis. The main conclusion is that the tool appears feasible and engaging for classroom use, and that the action logs can support research on student interaction patterns and learning analytics. The paper explicitly notes that future research is needed to evaluate learning outcomes more rigorously.

identified_tools.name: GenAI (General)
identified_tools.description: A generic AI-enabled educational tool for explaining and simulating social media platform mechanisms, including data collection, profiling, engagement, clustering, and recommendation with real-time visualizations and classroom analytics.
identified_tools.use_case: Used as the basis for the Somekone XAI tool, an Instagram-like classroom platform for grades 4-9 to teach AI-driven profiling, clustering, engagement-based recommending, and social media data mechanisms.

quality_tier_rationale: This paper is a tool/resource description with a case example and usage analytics, not an experimental study comparing learning outcomes. It does not report causal evidence, randomized assignment, or literacy outcome measures.
impact_tier_rationale: No effect sizes or comparative outcome data are reported for reading/literacy instruction. The paper discusses intended learning outcomes and pilot usage only, so instructional impact cannot be assessed.
